description: Liofilchem's ready-to-use plates and tubes support routine microbial isolation, cultivation and identification in clinical, food testing and research laboratories. Selective and chromogenic media help laboratories target specific organisms and differentiate colonies within established testing workflows.

Liofilchem's AST discs and MIC strips support antimicrobial susceptibility testing by disc diffusion and minimum inhibitory concentration determination. Laboratories can select products for their organism–antimicrobial combinations and apply current EUCAST or CLSI methods and interpretive criteria, as appropriate.

Sacace's real-time PCR kits support molecular testing for hepatitis viruses, HIV, HPV, respiratory pathogens and sexually transmitted infections. The portfolio offers qualitative detection and, where available, quantitative assays, with kit selection guided by the target, specimen type and compatible PCR platform.

ViennaLab's StripAssay kits use reverse-hybridization technology to detect defined genetic variants through a strip-based workflow. Applications span pharmacogenetics, thrombophilia and selected HLA-associated markers, helping molecular laboratories build targeted genotyping panels.

Micreos' PhageGuard solutions use bacteriophages to target Listeria and Salmonella in food-processing applications. Designed to complement existing hygiene and food-safety controls, these biocontrol tools can be evaluated for specific food matrices and processing conditions, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.

Medix Biochemica supplies antibodies, antigens and enzymes for IVD assay development and manufacturing. The portfolio helps R&D and procurement teams source critical biological components for assay design, validation and ongoing production.

Candor Bioscience, part of the Medix Biochemica group, offers LowCross-Buffer, Assay Defender and HAMA blockers to address interference in immunoassays. These reagents help development teams reduce nonspecific binding and antibody-mediated interference, with selection and performance verified in the intended assay format.
